jobs.title: Labortechniker/in (CTA/MTA/BTA) – Dortmund
jobs.description_html:
Deutsch

Über Biolyz

Biolyz ist ein Full-Stack-Unternehmen für speichelbasierte Biomarker-Tests mit der Mission, den Zugang zu Biomarker-Analytik für alle Menschen weltweit zu beschleunigen. Wir bieten eine nicht-invasive Testlösung, bei der Athleten und Trainer einfach ein Wattestäbchen verwenden, um Speichelproben zu sammeln, die wir innerhalb von 48 Stunden mittels Massenspektrometrie über mehr als 60 Biomarker hinweg analysieren, die Stress, Erholung, Stoffwechsel und Entzündung abdecken. Unsere Plattform liefert Trainern und Athleten direkt personalisierte Echtzeit-Einblicke. Mit über 2,5 Millionen analysierten Biomarkern bei Teams aus der Champions League, der Bundesliga, der Premier League, der Ligue 1 und anderen Sportarten hat Biolyz die besten Athleten ihres Fachs unterstützt.

Die Rolle

Als Labortechniker/in (CTA/MTA/BTA) an unserem Standort in Dortmund bist du das operative Herzstück unseres LC-MS/MS-Teams in Europa. Das ist keine reine Routineposition — du verantwortest den Probenworkflow vom Eingang bis zur Messung, sorgst dafür, dass unsere Prozesse sauber dokumentiert und kontinuierlich verbessert werden. Deine Arbeit ermöglicht direkt die Biomarker-Einblicke, die wir an Profisportvereine und leistungsstarke Organisationen in ganz Europa liefern.

Du arbeitest selbstständig im Laboralltag und stehst gleichzeitig in engem Kontakt mit unseren Wissenschaftlerinnen und der Laborleitung — löst technische Herausforderungen im laufenden Betrieb, wartest Instrumente und trägst zu den Qualitätsstandards bei, die Biolyz ausmachen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Probenannahme, -vorbereitung und -bearbeitung nach SOP (Aliquotierung, Verdünnung, Extraktion, Filtration) mit automatisierten Liquid-Handler-Workflows

  • Routinewartung, Kalibrierung und Funktionschecks von Liquid Handlern und Laborgeräten

  • Genaue Dokumentation aller Laboraktivitäten: Messprotokolle, Wartungslogs, Abweichungen und CAPA-Maßnahmen gemäß internen Qualitätsstandards

  • Mitarbeit an SOP-Entwicklung, Prozessverbesserungen und Labororganisation (Reagenzienverwaltung, Bestandsführung, Ordnung)

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als CTA (Chemisch-Technischer Assistent), BTA (Biologisch-Technischer Assistent), MTA (Medizinisch-Technischer Assistent) oder vergleichbar

  • 2–5+ Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Routinebetrieb eines Labors (Probenworkflow, Messbetrieb, QC)

  • Fundierte praktische Kenntnisse in der Probenvorbereitung und kontaminationsarmem Arbeiten (Carryover- und Kontaminationsmanagement)

  • Erfahrung in qualitätsgeregelten Laborumgebungen mit sauberer SOP-Dokumentation

  • Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten, Routineprobleme zu beheben und bei Bedarf zu eskalieren

  • Hohe Sorgfalt, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und zuverlässige Dokumentationsgewohnheiten

  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

Nice to Have

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit LC-MS/MS-Instrumenten, insbesondere SCIEX QTRAP-Systemen

  • Erfahrung im Betrieb oder in der Programmierung von automatisierten Liquid Handlern

  • Kenntnisse von LIMS-Plattformen

  • Kenntnisse von ISO 15189, GMP oder anderen Qualitätsmanagementsystemen

  • Interesse an Sportwissenschaft, Leistungsdiagnostik oder Gesundheitstechnologie

Standort & Vergütung

  • Dortmund, Deutschland (vor Ort)

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt basierend auf Erfahrung und Verantwortungsumfang

  • Team-Leistungsbonus von bis zu ~15% des Bruttogehalts

  • Langfristige Unternehmensbeteiligung — profitiere vom langfristigen Erfolg von Biolyz

English

About Biolyz

Biolyz is a full-stack saliva-based biomarker testing company on a mission to accelerate access to biomarker analytics for all humans, globally. We offer a non-invasive testing solution whereby athletes and coaches simply use a cotton swab to collect saliva, which we analyze via mass spectrometry within 48 hours across 60+ biomarkers covering stress, recovery, metabolism, and inflammation. Our platform delivers real-time, hyper-personalized insights directly to coaches and athletes. Having tested over 2.5 million biomarkers across teams in the Champions League, Bundesliga, Premier League and Ligue 1 and other sports, Biolyz has powered the best athletes in their field.

About the Role

As a Laboratory Technician (CTA/MTA/BTA) at our Dortmund site, you'll be at the operational core of our LC-MS/MS team in Europe. This isn't a routine lab role — you'll own the sample workflow from receipt to measurement, keeping our processes clean, documented, and continuously improving. Your work directly enables the biomarker insights we deliver to professional sports clubs and high-performance organizations across Europe.

You'll work independently on day-to-day lab operations while staying closely connected to our scientists and lab leadership — solving technical challenges in real time, maintaining instruments, and contributing to the quality standards that define Biolyz's output.

What You'll Do

  • Receive, prepare, and process samples following SOPs (aliquoting, dilution, extraction, filtration) using automated liquid handler workflows

  • Perform routine maintenance, calibration, and functional checks on liquid handlers and lab equipment

  • Document all lab activity accurately: measurement logs, maintenance records, deviations, and CAPA actions in line with internal quality standards

  • Contribute to SOP development, process improvements, and lab organization (reagent management, inventory, housekeeping)

What We're Looking For

  • Completed qualification as CTA (Chemisch-Technischer Assistent), BTA (Biologisch-Technischer Assistent), MTA (Medizinisch-Technischer Assistent), or equivalent

  • 2–5+ years of hands-on experience in routine lab operations (sample workflow, measurement, QC)

  • Solid practical skills in sample preparation and contamination-aware working (carryover and contamination management)

  • Experience in quality-regulated lab environments with clean SOP documentation

  • Ability to work independently, troubleshoot routine issues, and escalate appropriately

  • Strong attention to detail, structured work style, and reliable documentation habits

  • Good communication skills in German and English

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS instruments, particularly SCIEX QTRAP systems

  • Experience operating or programming automated liquid handlers

  • Familiarity with LIMS platforms

  • Understanding of ISO 15189, GMP, or other quality management standards

  • Interest in sports science, performance diagnostics, or health technology

Location & Compensation

  • Dortmund, Germany (on-site)

  • Competitive fixed salary based on experience and scope of responsibility

  • Team performance bonus of up to ~15% of gross salary

  • Long-term equity participation — share in Biolyz's success

jobs.title: Business & Medical Development Intern
jobs.description_html:
About Biolyz

Biolyz is a full-stack saliva-based biomarker testing company on a mission to accelerate access to biomarker analytics for all humans, globally. We offer a non-invasive testing solution whereby athletes and coaches simply use a cotton swab to collect saliva, which we analyze via mass spectrometry within 48 hours across 60+ biomarkers covering stress, recovery, metabolism, and inflammation. Our platform delivers real-time, hyper-personalized insights directly to coaches and athletes. Having tested over 2.5 million biomarkers across teams in the Champions League, Bundesliga, Premier League and Ligue 1 and other sports, Biolyz has powered the best athletes in their field.

About the Role

This internship sits at the intersection of science and commercial strategy. As a Business & Medical Development Intern, you'll work alongside the founding team to help Biolyz expand into new sports clubs, leagues, clinical networks, and institutional partnerships. You'll contribute to both the commercial side (business development, outreach, partnerships) and the medical/scientific side (supporting relationships with sports medicine professionals, research collaborators, and health institutions).

This is a generalist, high-impact role for someone curious, driven, and excited about the future of precision health in sports. You'll gain a rare front-row seat to how a science-driven startup builds its market.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and research potential clients, partners, and distribution channels across professional sports, sports medicine, and clinical diagnostics

  • Support outreach and relationship management with sports clubs, performance institutes, sports medicine practitioners, and academic/research institutions

  • Prepare pitch materials, partnership proposals, and presentations for prospective clients and investors

  • Assist in the development of medical and scientific communication materials (white papers, case studies, product summaries)

  • Track and report on business development pipeline, outreach metrics, and market intelligence

  • Coordinate with the scientific and lab teams to ensure accurate representation of Biolyz's technology and capabilities

  • Support ad-hoc projects across strategy, marketing, and operations as the company scales

What We're Looking For

  • Currently studying (or recently graduated from) a degree in life sciences, medicine, sports science, business, or a related field

  • Strong interest in both the commercial and scientific sides of healthcare/sports technology

  • Excellent communication and writing skills in English; German or other languages are a bonus

  • Proactive, self-starter mindset — comfortable with ambiguity and eager to take ownership

  • Strong research and analytical skills; ability to synthesize complex information clearly

  • Proficiency in standard productivity tools (Google Workspace, PowerPoint/Keynote, etc.)

Nice to Have

  • Prior internship experience in a startup, life sciences company, sports organization, or consulting firm

  • Understanding of sports performance, injury prevention, or biomarker science

  • Existing network in professional sports, sports medicine, or health tech

  • Experience with CRM tools or business development workflows

Location & Details

  • 80% in person (with remote parts) from our office in Hamburg

  • Duration: 5-6 months

  • Start date: October

  • Stipend: competitive internship compensation

jobs.title: Marketing (Content & Social Media) Intern
jobs.description_html:
About Biolyz

Biolyz is a full-stack saliva-based biomarker testing company on a mission to accelerate access to biomarker analytics for all humans, globally. We offer a non-invasive testing solution whereby athletes and coaches simply use a cotton swab to collect saliva, which we analyze via mass spectrometry within 48 hours across 60+ biomarkers covering stress, recovery, metabolism, and inflammation. Our platform delivers real-time, hyper-personalized insights directly to coaches and athletes. Having tested over 2.5 million biomarkers across teams in the Champions League, Bundesliga, Premier League and Ligue 1 and other sports, Biolyz has powered the best athletes in their field.

About the Role

We're looking for a Content & Social Media Intern who wants to help tell the Biolyz story everywhere it happens, not just on a feed. You'll create the content that carries our brand across social media, partner activations, and the events and trade fairs where we meet clubs, coaches, and athletes face to face.

This isn't a "write captions and schedule posts" role. You'll travel with the team, go behind the scenes at elite sports clubs, and take ownership of our presence at industry events and fairs, defining, planning, and running them, not just capturing content there. You'll also support partnership moments with the right visual and written content. You'll capture real moments with your phone or a camera, craft assets with AI tools, and turn cutting-edge science into content that feels human, exciting, and shareable. You'll have real creative ownership from day one.

The stories are already there: extraordinary athletes, fascinating science, meaningful partnerships. Your job is to find them and tell them in a way that stops the scroll, wherever they show up.

What You'll Do

  • Own Biolyz's content across channels (primarily Instagram, plus partnership and event materials) end to end: strategy, creation, publishing, and community engagement

  • Support partnerships with content and collateral for partner clubs, co-marketing, and brand collaborations

  • Define, plan, and manage Biolyz's presence at events, conferences, and trade fairs, from picking the right events and setting the plan to running logistics and owning execution on-site

  • Represent Biolyz at events, conferences, and trade fairs, capturing content on-site and helping the team make the most of those moments

  • Travel with the team to experience elite sports environments, training sessions, and club partnerships firsthand

  • Shoot and produce original photo and video content using your phone and cameras, in labs, on pitches, at competitions, at events, wherever the story is

  • Meet and capture the athletes, coaches, partners, and personalities behind the Biolyz story

  • Design high-quality creatives and visual assets for social media, campaigns, partnership materials, and event collateral

  • Leverage AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, CapCut AI, Adobe Firefly, etc.) to ideate faster, iterate quicker, and produce at a high standard

  • Track performance metrics and use insights to evolve content strategy

What We're Looking For

  • You're a natural on social media (Instagram in particular) and understand what works, what doesn't, and why

  • You shoot confidently with a phone and/or camera and have a genuine creative eye

  • You've used AI tools for creative work (image generation, video editing, design assistance, whatever your toolkit is)

  • You're self-directed and comfortable owning something from brief to published, including on-site at an event or fair

  • A small but solid portfolio of creatives and assets you've produced (social posts, campaigns, motion content, brand visuals, anything that shows your range)

Nice to Have

  • Interest or experience in partnerships, sponsorships, or event and fair coordination

  • Experience with motion graphics or short-form video editing (Reels, TikToks)

  • Familiarity with design tools like Figma, Canva Pro, or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Interest in sports science, health, or performance; curiosity is enough

  • Experience managing a brand or personal account with real traction

What You'll Get

  • Real ownership of Biolyz's content across social, partnerships, and events from day one

  • Travel to elite sports venues, training facilities, club partnerships, and trade fairs across Europe

  • Up-close access to world-class athletes, coaches, partners, and performance science in action

  • A front-row seat at a fast-growing biotech company that's changing how sport is played

How to Apply

Show us something you've made. A small portfolio of creatives or assets you're proud of is all we ask for, it doesn't need to be polished, just real.

jobs.title: Founder's Associate
jobs.description_html:
About Biolyz

Biolyz is a full-stack saliva-based biomarker testing company on a mission to accelerate access to biomarker analytics for all humans, globally. We offer a non-invasive testing solution whereby athletes and coaches simply use a cotton swab to collect saliva, which we analyze via mass spectrometry within 48 hours across 60+ biomarkers covering stress, recovery, metabolism, and inflammation. Our platform delivers real-time, hyper-personalized insights directly to coaches and athletes. Having tested over 2.5 million biomarkers across teams in the Champions League, Bundesliga, Premier League and Ligue 1 and other sports, Biolyz has powered the best athletes in their field.

About the Role

We're looking for a Founder's Associate to work directly alongside our CEO and help drive the most critical initiatives across the business. This isn't a traditional chief-of-staff role — it's a high-impact, high-ownership position for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and gets things done. You'll be in the room (and on the calls) where it matters most: strategy sessions, key partnerships, investor conversations, and operational problem-solving.

You'll act as a force multiplier for the CEO — tracking priorities, connecting dots across teams, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. This role is ideal for someone who has seen how high-performance organizations operate — whether in investment banking, consulting, or a fast-moving startup — and is now ready to build something meaningful in the intersection of sports science, biotech, and data.

Expect a steep learning curve, long hours, and the kind of exposure that would take years to get anywhere else.

What You'll Do

  • Work side-by-side with the CEO on the company's most important strategic and operational priorities

  • Own and track critical action items across all functions, ensuring nothing is dropped or delayed

  • Prepare materials for board meetings, investor updates, key client presentations, and internal reviews

  • Conduct research and build business cases to support strategic decisions (new markets, partnerships, product direction)

  • Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the business and drive solutions proactively

  • Represent the CEO in internal meetings and with external stakeholders when needed

  • Act as a trusted thought partner — challenging assumptions, stress-testing plans, and asking the right questions

What We're Looking For

  • 2–3 years of experience in investment banking, management consulting, or a high-growth startup

  • Exceptional business acumen — you understand strategy, finance, and operations, and you connect them naturally

  • An extreme sense of urgency — you treat every day like it counts, because it does

  • Highly organized and structured, with the ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — crisp, clear, and confident with executives and external partners

  • Comfortable with long hours and high pressure — this role is not a 9-to-5, and you wouldn't have it any other way

  • Proactive and self-directed — you don't wait to be told what to do; you see what needs to happen and make it happen

Nice to Have

  • Experience in sports, sports science, elite athletics, or working with sports organizations

  • Background in laboratory operations, biotech, life sciences, or diagnostics

  • Familiarity with data, analytics, or BI tools (e.g. SQL, Looker, Tableau, or similar)

  • Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, healthtech, or fast-scaling hardware + software businesses

Why Biolyz

  • Direct access to the CEO from day one — real ownership, not busy work

  • A front-row seat to building a category-defining company in biomarker analytics

  • Tight-knit team with deep expertise in sports science, lab tech, and data

  • The chance to work with elite sports teams and world-class athletes

  • Fast progression for the right person — this role is a launchpad, not a landing spot
